# Onboarding Checklist

*(draft — will firm up once we know our building, IRB protocol numbers, and scanner access at UT Dallas)*

**First week**

- [ ] Building/lab space orientation; keys or badge access
- [ ] UT Dallas NetID and required IT accounts set up
- [ ] Added to lab Slack, email list, and shared calendar
- [ ] MRI/lab safety training scheduled (if your role involves scanning)
- [ ] One-on-one with every current lab member, not just the PI

**First month**

- [ ] CITI human-subjects research training completed
- [ ] Added to relevant IRB protocol(s) once trained
- [ ] Lab GitHub org access granted; analysis environment set up (see [Data Management & Security](data-management.qmd))
- [ ] HPC / computing cluster account requested, if needed for your project
- [ ] Read 3–5 foundational lab papers (list maintained separately)
- [ ] Give a short "who I am / what I'm interested in" lab meeting talk

**First three months**

- [ ] Draft an individual development plan / research plan with the PI
- [ ] Identify a first small, well-scoped project or contribution
- [ ] Understand the authorship and data-management policies well enough to explain them back
